name: How much does it cost to repair a drafty window?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to repair a drafty window?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of repairing a drafty window varies based on the cause and extent of the problem. Simple repairs, such as re-caulking or replacing weatherstripping, are generally inexpensive. More complex issues, like repairing a warped frame or replacing sashes, will cost more. Factors like the type of window, accessibility, and the number of windows needing repair also influence the total price. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on the repair needed, from inexpensive re-caulking to more complex frame repairs.
